question.text: The number of ways, in which the letters $\mathrm{A}, \mathrm{B}, \mathrm{C}$, D, E can be placed in the 8 boxes of the figure below so that no row remains empty and at most one letter can be placed in a box, is :

solution.text: $\begin{aligned} & =\text { Total }-\left[\left(\mathrm{All} \mathrm{in}_1 \text { and } \mathrm{R}_3\right)+\left(\text { All in } \mathrm{R}_2 \text { and } \mathrm{R}_3\right)+\right. \\ & \left.\left(\text { All in } \mathrm{R}_1 \text { and } \mathrm{R}_2\right)\right] \\ & ={ }^8 \mathrm{C}_5 \cdot \mid 5-\left\{\underline{5}+\left\lfloor 5+{ }^6 \mathrm{C}_5 \cdot \underline{5}\right\}\right. \\ & =\lfloor 5(56-1-1-6)=120(48) \\ & =5760\end{aligned}$
